name: @fora-protocol/sdk-types
description: Generated TypeScript types export: Zod schemas (./wire/schemas), generated from the proto via JSON Schema, + the protocol and manifest version constants (./wire/version) and vocabulary constants (./vocab/*), generated from the proto by buf. Not published on its own: it ships inside @fora-protocol/sdk (built by sdk/ts/scripts/build.mjs), which exports these subpaths unchanged.
